name: Risperidone Microspheres Long-Acting Injectable
summary: Risperidone microspheres LAI is a long-acting injection that slowly releases risperidone over two weeks. It is approved for schizophrenia and for ongoing (maintenance) treatment of bipolar I disorder.
description: Risperidone microspheres LAI is a long-acting injection that uses tiny biodegradable beads (microspheres) to release risperidone over a two-week period. It is approved for schizophrenia and as ongoing (maintenance) treatment for bipolar I disorder. Because it is given less often, it makes it easier to stay on treatment and keeps drug levels in the blood steady. It works by blocking dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2A receptors, which helps ease both the positive symptoms of psychosis (such as hallucinations) and the negative ones (such as low motivation), and helps keep mood stable.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Risperidone microspheres LAI is an extended-release formulation using biodegradable polymer microspheres to deliver risperidone over a two-week period. It is approved for schizophrenia and as maintenance therapy in bipolar I disorder. This formulation makes it easier to stay on treatment by reducing how often doses are needed and keeping drug levels steady. It works by blocking dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2A receptors, helping to ease both positive and negative symptoms of psychosis and stabilize mood.
